items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Did you ever work in the same band with Sidney Bean? ... INTERVIEWEE: No, no, no. I just wanted you to mention him. No, I don't work with him.

ctx.x: I see. Morris French. It's like, if I can't play tonight I'll come, I hire Winner or some of them boys will go play my plays, I'd say, because I can't play, you know. They go play, Homer, his brother Clemence, some of them boys like that, well they go play. They do for me, if they can't play, they call me, I'll go play in their plays.
Did you ever work in the same band with Sidney Bean? No, no, no.
I just wanted you to mention him. No, I don't work with him. Andy Morris had to work with the band with him though. What about Lee Collins, you ever work with him?
